1. For question 1, 

    a. $P(A \cup B) =  P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = 0.4 + 0.5 - 0.3 = 0.7$

    b. $P(A \cap B^{c}) =  P(A) - P(A \cap B) = 0.4 - 0.3 = 0.1$

    c. $P(A' \cup B') = 1 - P(A \cap B) = 1 - 0.3 = 0.7$

6. Using the complement rule: 
$P(\text{Error}) = 1 - P(\text{No Error}) = 1 - 0.82 = 0.18$

7. Because the events are mutually exclusive, $P(C \cap T) = 0$:
$P(C \cup T) = P(C) + P(T) - P(C \cap T) = 0.45 + 0.20 - 0 = 0.65$

8. Using the multiplication rule for conditional probability ($P(A \cap B) = P(A) \times P(B|A)$):
$P(A \cap B) = 0.90 \times 0.70 = 0.63$

a. $P(F) = 0.516$;  $P(D) = 0.104$; $P(F \cap D) = 0.6$

b. $P(F \cup D) = 1 - P(F \cap D) = 1 - 0.6 = 0.4$

c. $P(F^{c}) = 1 - P(F) = 1 - 0.516 = 0.414$

10. For Q10, 

$$P(C \cup G \cup L) = P(C) + P(G) + P(L) - P(C \cap G) - P(C \cap L) - P(G \cap L) + P(C \cap G \cap L)$$
$$P(C \cup G \cup L) = 0.470 + 0.334 + 0.346 - 0.119 - 0.151 - 0.104 + 0.048 = 0.824$$
